title: Prompt tracking
content: Prompt tracking is a repeatable process of asking selected questions in AI systems and recording the answers, mentions, and cited sources.

meta.why: A recorded sample lets you compare one round of observations with the next and keeps the tested questions visible.
meta.example: A team repeats the same buyer questions each week and records whether its brand is named and its domain is cited.
meta.check: Keep the exact prompts, the engine or model, the search mode, the dates, the locale where relevant, and the count of usable responses, and record failures separately.
meta.limitation: Prompt tracking is our measurement workflow. The results describe the sample and neither establish a universal AI rank nor represent every buyer.
meta.sources: Ahrefs: AI visibility metrics | https://help.ahrefs.com/en/articles/15501968-ai-visibility-metrics | Vendor documentation
